auth-login.name: Login
auth-login.description: Submit credentials; success reaches Dashboard, invalid credentials show an alert, and transport failure retains values for a retry.

auth-register.name: Register account
auth-register.description: Submit viewer registration; duplicate email, password confirmation, and password-policy errors are shown; transport failure retains entered data for retry.

dashboard-unauthenticated-redirect.name: Protect dashboard
dashboard-unauthenticated-redirect.description: Opening Dashboard without an initialized authenticated session redirects to Login.

dashboard-profile-display.name: View profile
dashboard-profile-display.description: Reach Dashboard through Login and read fixture-backed profile name, email, phone, and account status.

dashboard-logout.name: Logout
dashboard-logout.description: Activate Logout, clear local authentication state and cookies, and return to Login.

public-home.name: Home Page
public-home.description: Reach the landing through site navigation and read concrete landing content and real media.

public-header-navigation.name: Navigate public site
public-header-navigation.description: Use desktop or compact-overlay navigation, including the Tenndalux WebP logo and Footer links, to reach public destinations or return Home.

public-contact-submit.name: Submit contact request
public-contact-submit.description: Complete the labeled contact form; validate optional space count, submit optional project details, show success feedback, and preserve values after a rejected request.

auth-session-refresh-contact.name: Refresh session during contact submission
auth-session-refresh-contact.description: A stale access token refreshes and replays the unchanged contact request; rejected refresh clears tokens and redirects to Login.

public-faq-toggle.name: Read FAQ
public-faq-toggle.description: Open a FAQ question to read its answer and close it again.

public-gallery-video.name: Watch gallery video
public-gallery-video.description: Open a gallery video card, inspect its playable modal source, and close the dialog with focus restored.

public-brand-video.name: Watch brand video
public-brand-video.description: Open the Why Tenndalux brand video, inspect the native player, and dismiss the modal.

public-products-display.name: Browse products
public-products-display.description: Reach Products from Services and read concrete product cards.

public-products-filter.name: Filter products
public-products-filter.description: Choose a product category and reset it to show the matching cards.

public-product-details.name: Read product details
public-product-details.description: Open a product detail dialog, read data for the selected product, and close it.

public-services-display.name: Browse services
public-services-display.description: Reach Services and read concrete initial solution content.

public-services-tab.name: Switch service solution
public-services-tab.description: Choose Cortinas, Recubrimientos, Exteriores, or Tecnología, including a curtain model where offered.

public-services-exterior-mobile-detail.name: Read exterior solution on mobile
public-services-exterior-mobile-detail.description: Open an exterior solution card on mobile, read its bottom sheet, and close it by backdrop.

public-blog-list.name: Browse blog
public-blog-list.description: Navigate to Blog, read API-backed cards including later pages or a valid empty state, and recover an initial or later-page API failure with retry.

public-blog-filter.name: Filter blog
public-blog-filter.description: Search or choose a tag, read matching cards or the no-results state, then clear filters.

public-blog-detail.name: Read article
public-blog-detail.description: Follow an article card, read its title and content, and retain the matching browser title; a missing article returns to Blog and an unavailable request can retry.

public-blog-share.name: Share article
public-blog-share.description: Share an article using native sharing or clipboard fallback; a denied browser integration leaves the article usable without an unhandled rejection.

public-portfolio-list.name: Browse portfolio
public-portfolio-list.description: Navigate to Portfolio, read API-backed cards including later pages or a valid empty state, and recover an initial or later-page API failure with retry.

public-portfolio-filter.name: Filter portfolio
public-portfolio-filter.description: Choose a category, read its projects, and reset to Todos.

public-portfolio-showreel.name: Watch portfolio showreel
public-portfolio-showreel.description: Open the showreel, read its current video, choose next or previous video, and close the overlay.

public-portfolio-detail.name: Read project
public-portfolio-detail.description: Follow a project card, read its title and content, and retain the matching browser title; a missing project returns to Portfolio and an unavailable request can retry.

public-warranty-documents.name: Read warranty documents
public-warranty-documents.description: Reach Garantías through Footer, read published PDFs or the empty state and policy, open a document, and retry a failed list.

public-home-hero-image.name: Display CMS Home hero image
public-home-hero-image.description: Navigate Home and display the API-backed hero image; absent, unavailable, or broken CMS media retains the bundled cover.

admin-warranty-document-publish.name: Publish warranty document
admin-warranty-document-publish.description: A staff user with Django model permissions creates a published PDF document, reopens its saved row and file, and sees validation for an invalid PDF.

admin-home-hero-image-update.name: Update Home hero image
admin-home-hero-image-update.description: A staff user with Django attachment permissions uploads or selects Home hero media, sees the saved thumbnail, rejects a non-image, and recovers a failed uploader save by seeing its alert, choosing a replacement if needed, and submitting again.
